documents.title: Guidelines for Academic Use
documents.summary: University-wide academic guidelines adapted from a March 2025 working-group report. They require each course syllabus to state GAI expectations, leave permitted uses to instructors and units, and ask schools to update honor codes, reject detectors as sole proof, and ensure equitable access. A discussion framework prompts program-level conversations; no tiers or default stance are set.
documents.stance_why: The document sets no ban or permission itself: 'instructors set expectations for their classes, and these expectations can differ' and 'the permitted uses of GAI may not be the same in every course or on every assignment', so the decision is handed to instructors and units. It only requires each syllabus to carry a statement ('Include GAI expectations and policies on each course syllabus'). No named tiers are offered.
